sources.title_en: AI agents do more of the work in model development, but humans still make the decisions
sources.title_original: AI agents do more of the work in model development, but humans still make the decisions
sources.summary:
A research team analyzed 769 task logs from building its own AI model. AI agents supplied up to 55 percent of method proposals, but humans made more than 85 percent of final decisions. A third of the tasks wouldn't have been attempted without AI. The authors warn that more agent activity doesn't mean more autonomy.

sources.summary: 作者抢先装上还没正式官宣的 DeepSeek Harness 桌面版，实测了它的登录引导、任务模式、插件系统和完整思维链展示，并用“读取本地环境，生成一个模拟 macOS 的演示网页”做了对比测试。结果很反常识：便宜的 DeepSeek V4.1 flash 在 Harness 里还原出了非常接近本机桌面的交互效果，速度快、过程清晰；而同定位的 GPT-6 Luna 反而更像凭理解重画了一版。模型之外，任务规划和执行框架可能才是下一轮差距。
